title: Homomorphism from indices to product characters
statement: For positive $m$ and a natural number $n$, the map sending each tuple $\alpha\in(\mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z})^n$ to the product character $x\mapsto\prod_{i=1}^n\chi_{\alpha_i}(x_i)$ is an additive-group homomorphism into the group of complex-valued additive characters on $(\mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z})^n$.
